en: What did Ruth say that made Naomi realize she was determined to follow her back to Israel? Ruth left her father and mother and her homeland and came to live with a people she did not know—the people of Israel. Under whose wings did she take refuge? Was Boaz willing to spread the corner of his garment over Ruth? Why or why not? Whose grandfather was the son of Boaz and Ruth? Both being Moabite women, what is the difference between Ruth and the woman mentioned in Numbers 25?
